fact: On 2 October 2026 the Minister of Security, presenting his ministry's achievements for 2022-2026, listed the dematerialisation of certain working tools, notably the main courante and SYGESS, among them, and said the ministry would accelerate the digital transformation of the security services; no count of commissariats or brigades, system name or rollout date is given.
title: JEPPC 2026 : Le ministre Sana présente les acquis dans la modernisation de son département
